program_narrative: PORTTRAN is a portfolio transaction program (inventory subtype 'unknown'; it reads a sequential file, displays totals and ends with GOBACK) that validates transaction records. It opens TRANSACTION-FILE for input (record TRANSACTION-RECORD from copybook TRNREC) and PORTFOLIO-FILE for I-O (indexed, random access by PORT-ID; its record layout comes from copybook PORTREC, which is unresolved). If the transaction file opened with status '00', the main loop repeats 2000-PROCESS-TRANSACTIONS until end of file or until more than 100 errors have been counted; each pass reads one transaction, counts it and validates it. Validation checks that the portfolio ID is present and found on PORTFOLIO-FILE by key, that the transaction type is 'BU', 'SL', 'TR' or 'FE', that the quantity is greater than zero, and that price and amount are greater than zero unless the type is 'TR'; a valid transaction only increments the processed count, an invalid one performs 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE, which counts the error and calls ERRPROC with ERR-MESSAGE. The paragraphs that apply buys, sells and fees to the portfolio record, reject transfers, and pass an audit record to AUDPROC (2200-UPDATE-POSITIONS and its callees) are never performed from the entry point; 2200-UPDATE-POSITIONS is confirmed dead code. At the end both files are closed and the read, processed and error counts are displayed. Error conditions handled: file open failures, missing or unknown portfolio ID, invalid transaction type, and non-positive quantity, price or amount.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
pseudocode: -- Main control paragraph: initialise, process the transaction file, terminate
IF transaction_file_status = '00' THEN  -- WS-TRAN-STATUS, set by OPEN of TRANSACTION-FILE
WHILE NOT (end_of_file OR error_count > 100) DO  -- PERFORM ... UNTIL (test before); END-OF-FILE is true when WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
RETURN to caller (or terminate if main program)  -- GOBACK
paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Main control paragraph: initialise, process the transaction file, terminate
CALL 1000-initialize
IF transaction_file_status = '00' THEN  -- WS-TRAN-STATUS, set by OPEN of TRANSACTION-FILE
  WHILE NOT (end_of_file OR error_count > 100) DO  -- PERFORM ... UNTIL (test before); END-OF-FILE is true when WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
    CALL 2000-process-transactions
  END WHILE
END IF
CALL 3000-terminate
RETURN to caller (or terminate if main program)  -- GOBACK

annotations.note: Main loop runs only when the transaction file opened successfully; it stops at end of file or once WS-ERROR-COUNT exceeds 100.
